rows.grounds: compound of dīpa (lamp) and nātha (lord), object of propitiation
name of the deity identified as the lamp-lord
prescriptive verbal form expressing ritual petition
quotative or concluding particle marking the instruction

items.question: Must Bhairava as lord of the lamp be ritually propitiated?
premises: The lamp-lord is named as Bhairava.
A prescriptive act of propitiation is enjoined.
The instruction is formally concluded with iti.
items.inference: Therefore Bhairava in the form of the lamp-lord is to be propitiated.
items.plain_english: Thus one should propitiate Bhairava as the lord of the lamp.
